method: Published JSON receipts preserve observed counts, outcomes, phases and causes, with the exact SHA-256 of each private raw log. They are structured summaries, not byte-for-byte copies of the logs. Existing width JSON evidence remains unchanged.
publicationBoundary: Only paths in receipts are published evidence files. Raw logs remain private and ignored; names in privateRawLogs are provenance identifiers, not links or expected checkout files. Raw trace bodies, absolute machine paths and credential material are excluded from published summaries.
